Question 6

The first term of a geometric sequence is 14 and the common ratio is 4. Written in sigma notation, what is the sum of the first 50 terms?

a
∑n=1508n
b
∑n=1504n+2
c
∑n=1504n
d
∑n=1508n−2
e
∑n=1504n−2
